header: """Reconstruct the unchanged evidence packet and run its complete finite audit."""
"""Configuration: repo root, budget.yaml, problems.yaml, lane/env resolution. No prices or caps live in code."""
"""The repository is the memory: hashing, freezing, JSON/JSONL helpers, provenance, attempt numbering."""
"""Run a problem's computational verifier on structured claims; write reports with witnesses (Idea 3).
The verifier package at problems/<slug>/verifier/verify.py exposes:
small_cases(params) -> dict            brute-force ground truth for the smallest instances (cached in verifier/data/)
REGRESSION: list[dict]                 claims with known outcomes that must pass before the verifier is accepted
The verifier FILTERS; it never certifies.
"""Audit a complete conditional minimum-witness cover, not just sampled moves.
Replays Horn splits/strictness, new rectangle paths, and the second-reduction
exclusions independently of each selector. Existing old-path and full-domain
audits are bound by hash. No theorem is certified by accepting a data flag.
from harness import config, store, verify
"""Independent local checks of every reduction path and Horn catalog entry.
Checks proof-rule premises and conclusions, not the greedy algorithm's choices.
The entire Horn catalog is regenerated with the independent tableau DP engine.
Neither step replaces the required cross-family mathematical proof review.
"""Audit a fixed complete-line prefix of the live exact-polynomial journal.
This checks finite certificate integrity and signs, independently evaluates all
recorded values, and separates total computation from the proposed terminal core.
It does not independently reimplement Normaliz or certify the mathematical cover.
No live source, cache, state, ledger or journal is modified.
"""Independent small-domain enumeration and literal reduction-certificate audit.
Regenerates partitions recursively and inners under kappa, independently of the
coin-DP/numpy selection that produced the data. Then checks each recorded Horn
split/rectangle exclusion and every retained strict Horn inequality. No baseline
or positivity of unchecked records is assumed.
"""Audit a fixed complete-line prefix of the small-domain exact-polynomial journal.
This checks finite certificate integrity and signs, independently evaluates all
recorded values, and separates total computation from the proposed terminal core.
It does not independently reimplement Normaliz or certify the mathematical cover.
No live source, cache, state, ledger or journal is modified.
"""Count the domain asserted by v005, without assuming its pending proof is correct.
This is a supervisor workload calculation, not a positivity certificate. No LR
coefficient or polynomial is computed, and no existing verifier file is changed.
The predicates transcribe Theorem 'Necessary conditions' and (18)--(20).
"""Generate the unconditional minimum-witness domain below size24.
The mathematical necessities of v005 do not need Pos22/Pos23: their use of the
baseline only gives a lower size bound. Enumerating the same literal conditions
from size1 instead lets a future full cover avoid the older sweep dependencies.
This program generates data and fresh base LR counts, not a positivity proof.
from harness import config, store, verify
"""Independently regenerate the entire conditional domain, sizes24--30.
Uses integer-part coin DP and literal theorem conditions, not the original
contained-ceiling recursion or its outer-shape pruning. Fresh base LR counts
are compared bijectively with the original c>=3 records, one outer at a time.
This is a completeness audit of finite code/data, not a Lean proof or a new
positivity certificate. It writes only independent supervisor run leaves.
"""Create a narrowly scoped mathematical evidence manifest or portable ZIP.
Only named mathematical source, inputs, audit outputs and manuscripts are
included. No ledger, provider conversation, review report, credentials or live
campaign state is copied. Frozen artifacts are preserved byte for byte.
"""Test the broad minimum-counterexample reduction from KTT factorization.
Source: Cho, Jung, Moon, DMTCS FPSAC 2008, Definition 1.2 and Theorem 1.3,
https://dmtcs.episciences.org/3592/pdf (p.485). This cites the KTT theorem,
not its earlier conjectural version. Published original:
An essential equality factors the stretching polynomial into subpartition
polynomials. Both outer sizes are strictly smaller when the original outer
has n positive parts. Hence a minimum-size negative-coefficient witness has
no such equality: if both factors had nonnegative monomial coefficients,
their product would as well. This implication still requires referee review
